verdict.rationale: Dialpad documents a company-level webhooks resource ([dialpad-docs-13] lists webhooks associated with the company), so registrable outbound HTTP callbacks exist. It also documents event subscriptions, though the cited one is delivered via websocket ([dialpad-docs-4]). The pack never explicitly shows that call and message events are delivered to these webhooks. Missing for 10: explicit docs on call/SMS event subscription types delivered via webhook, webhook creation/registration and payload/security (signing) details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
